info.name: NHI Backend API
info.description: All routes from internal/routes/routes.go: discovery under /api/v1, AWS integrations under /api/v1/integrations/aws, ISPM posture under /api/v1/ispm, NHI Genome under /api/v1/genome. Every protected route is also served under /api/... (without /v1; /me is /api/auth/me). Run Login first; it stores access_token/refresh_token. Optional query params are disabled by default; enable as needed. Unknown query params return 400 INVALID_QUERY_PARAM.

request.description: No auth. Returns {status, service}.
200 when Postgres answers (503 otherwise); reports each ClickHouse as ok, down or not_configured.

Body: email* (or username), password*. 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED on bad credentials, 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED for a disabled account with the right password, 429 RATE_LIMITED (Retry-After) after 60 tries a minute per address or 5 per account. Stores tokens in collection variables.
Same as Login (v1).
Body: refresh_token*. Single-use; rotated on every call.
Alias of /api/v1/refresh.
Body: refresh_token*.
Alias of /api/v1/logout.
Returns {user_id, tenant_id, db_name, role}.
Alias of /api/v1/me.

No query params.
selected_account_ids: <=200, each ^\d{12}$. selected_regions: <=200, 'global' or AWS region. Duplicates removed. 400 INVALID_SETTINGS if not tenant's own.

No query params. kpis: total_identities, total_credentials, active_credentials, orphaned_credentials, stale_identities, stale_credentials, publicly_accessible, shadow_identities, accounts_scanned, permission_utilization_pct, trust_edges, cross_account_trust_edges. charts: identities_by_type/_functional_class/_account/_region/_environment/_status, identity_growth, credential_growth, stale_vs_active, credential_types, top_owners, credentials_expiring_soon[{credential_id, credential_name, expires_at, days_remaining}], trust_edges_by_type[{edge_type,count}], event_volume[{date,count}] (30 days, CloudTrail, zero-filled; empty when CloudTrail cannot be read), credential_utilization[{bucket,count}] (used_7d, used_30d, used_90d, idle_90d, never_used). Plus activity_data_available and recent_changes.

recent_changes: last_scan_id, last_scan_at (also last_scan_time), previous_scan_id, previous_scan_at, total_changes, by_change_type, highlights[{change_type, entity_type, count, label}]; null before the first scan.
Newest finished scans (COMPLETED and PARTIAL; status says which) with change counts.

One scan's summary and a page of its changes. scan_id may be 'latest'. Response: scan{scan_id, status, account_id, started_at, completed_at, previous_scan_id, previous_scan_at}, summary{total, by_change_type, by_entity_type}, changes[{change_id, scan_id, scan_at, change_type, entity_type, entity_arn, entity_name, identity_id, credential_id, account_id, region, summary, details, detected_at}], pagination{page, limit, total, total_pages}. Also the reference names: top-level scan_id, status, scan_time, previous_scan_id; summary.created/deleted/modified/by_entity; changes[].id, entity_id, scan_time. 404 SCAN_NOT_FOUND.

Admin role required. The main list (what needs action), newest first; 41 scanner fields per finding (incl. ml_veto_score, ml_veto_model_version, value_fingerprint, noise_flags); timestamps always carry an offset. Every finding that is not marked safe is in exactly one of: main, /review, /repeated, /noise, /flagged.

query.description: Lookup mode: must be the ONLY query param. <=1000 chars. 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 AMBIGUOUS_FINDING.

request.description: Likely false alarms (alias: /findings/ml-flagged). Same as list with ml_flagged forced true.

query.description: bool (ignored: this route names its list)

request.description: Needs review: the models are unsure either way, so a person should decide (rescued FALSE_POSITIVE with ml_score >= 0.25, or weak REAL_SECRET). Same 41 fields.

query.description: bool (ignored: this route names its list)

request.description: The same value_fingerprint at 3+ different places in one commit (private-key detectors exempt). Group client-side by (platform, client_id, repository, commit_id, value_fingerprint) and by repeat count.

query.description: bool (ignored: this route names its list)

request.description: Values tagged in noise_flags: known_example_value, expired_signed_url, vector_image_file, integrity_hash, arn_identifier, password_hash, plain_url.

Counts for one list (main unless ml_flagged=true): total_findings, high/medium/low, affected_repositories, plus lists {main, review, repeated, noise, ml_flagged} for every list (they add up to all findings not marked safe).
Body: client_id*, file_path*, detector*, redacted*, reason. The signed-in user is recorded as dismissed_by.
JSON body; returns {ok} (false if nothing deleted).
Body: finding_id*, decision* (real_secret | false_positive). The signed-in user is recorded as decided_by.

Body: client_id 1-200, repository 1-500, optional platform (github | codecommit). Queues a full-history walk in the tenant's secscan_deepscan_<platform> table for the scanner worker. 202 {accepted: true, status: running, client_id, repo_key, platform, requested_at, already_running}. 400 INVALID_REPOSITORY when a GitHub repository is not owner/repo or a CodeCommit repository is not one of the client's onboarded ones; 404 CLIENT_NOT_FOUND.

query.description: codecommit | github; needed if repo exists on both (409 PLATFORM_REQUIRED)

request.description: {client_id, repo_key, platform, requested_at, completed_at, commits_scanned, findings, failed_at, error, status: not_started | running | complete | failed} (the same object with status not_started when none was requested). 409 PLATFORM_REQUIRED when the repository exists on both platforms.
Setup values, connected accounts, has_connected_account, exposure_enabled, can_manage.
Runs assume_role, read_access and events checks and saves the account. 429 AWS_VERIFY_IN_PROGRESS while another check runs.
Each requested platform is checked through the account's role and switched on only if its checks pass. Send false for both to switch scanning off.

Analyst or admin. Only the finding id and the change are needed. status ACCEPTED (with accepted_reason) | SUPPRESSED (with suppressed_until) | OPEN; assigned_to; note. 409 when the finding is already resolved by the engine.
